description_en: This operation searches a DNA library for matching or similar fingerprints
description_zh: 查询DNA底库中是否存在相同或者相近的DNA结果
name: SubmitFpShotJob

parameters.help_en:
The input file for the job. You can specify the file by using an OSS URL, an HTTP URL, or an ApsaraVideo VOD media asset.

OSS URL: A JSON string that contains the OSS triplet. Example: `{"Bucket":"test-bucket","Location":"oss-cn-shanghai","Object":"test.mp4"}`

HTTP URL: A publicly accessible URL. Example: `http://example-test-****.mp4`.

ApsaraVideo VOD media asset: a JSON string that contains the ID of the media asset. Example: `{"MediaId":"99238***321"}`

The region of the OSS bucket and the storage region of the media asset must be the same as the region where you use the ApsaraVideo Media Processing service
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The ID of the pipeline used for message notifications. You can find the pipeline ID under Global Settings > Pipelines in the ApsaraVideo Media Processing console
parameters.help_zh: 管道ID，用于绑定消息通知。可通过媒体处理控制台>全局设置>管道获取
parameters.name: pipeline_id

parameters.help_en: The video DNA job configurations. The value must be a JSON object. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93568.html
parameters.help_zh: 视频DNA配置，JSON对象。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93568.html
parameters.name: fp_shot_config

parameters.help_en: The user-defined data. The value can be up to 128 bytes in length and cannot start with a special character
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度128个字节，不能以特殊字符开头
parameters.name: user_data

JobId.description_en: The video DNA job ID. We recommend that you save this ID for subsequent calls to related operations
JobId.description_zh: 视频DNA作业ID。建议您保存此ID便于后续调用其他相关接口时使用
